text:
Maria Gonzalez: quick follow-up on PR #482 after merge  noticed a couple small follow-ups we should do before the next docs deploy: meter naming in Console (we're showing 'tokens_in' vs 'tokens'), add a Python SDK snippet for reading quota headers, and confirm the tier discount rounding language for legal.

Kevin Li: saw that too. on the meter name: platform team uses `tokens_in` internally but Console UX should show 'Tokens (consumed)'. I'll send a tiny rename PR to the UI repo.

Priya Nandakumar: I can add the Python snippet. propose:
```py
resp = client.generate(prompt)
print(resp.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining'))
```
is that ok? also plan to include an example showing how to fetch usage via the /usage endpoint for metering.

Jared Cohen: legal approved the discount wording except they want us to avoid the phrase "rounded up". change suggested: "discounts applied to billing units are calculated on per-invoice totals and rounded to the nearest cent." will that work?

Maria Gonzalez: Jared  that's perfect. I'll update the PR description and the pricing FAQ blurb.

Kevin Li: small UX ask: add a tooltip in the Console near "Metering units" that explains requests vs tokens. text: "Requests = API calls; Tokens = model input+output units used for pricing." Priya can link to that section.

Priya Nandakumar: on screenshots: I noticed one dashboard image still shows the old sidebar. I exported a clean crop at @2x and put in `/assets/console/usage-dashboard-2x.png`. Maria  did you want me to open a follow-up PR for that?

Maria Gonzalez: yes please open a tiny PR and reference the merged PR #482 so it's easy to track. CI will pick up image path changes.

Jared Cohen: also request from finance: add a one-line note in billing docs describing free-tier burst allowances (30 req/min, resets every minute) and how meter spikes are smoothed in analytics. nothing legal-y, just clarity.

Kevin Li: added a short paragraph in the draft. Priya  can you add the analytics smoothing note in the usage docs? Example: "Console aggregates per-minute buckets; short bursts may be averaged in charts but raw logs show per-request counts."

Priya Nandakumar: done in my local copy, pushing shortly. one more thing: the Python example should show how to parse headers into ints and a small retry hint. e.g.:
```py
remaining = int(resp.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining', 0))
reset = int(resp.headers.get('x-ratelimit-reset', 0))
if remaining < 5:
    time.sleep(max(0, reset - time.time()))
```

Maria Gonzalez: love it. that's helpful for customers. can we keep the snippet very short in the main docs and link to a longer example in the SDK cookbook?

Kevin Li: yep. we should also add a quick note in the migration guide for Dedicated customers: quotas are per-reservation; if you move to Dedicated, your quota tokens model changes. I added a bullet but please double-check.

Jared Cohen: FYI finance wants usage export samples in CSV in the billing docs. Priya  maybe add a sample download link or example fields: `timestamp, account_id, meter, value`?

Priya Nandakumar: will add CSV example fields and a tiny curl call to the /exports endpoint.

docs-bot: PR #482 merged by Maria Gonzalez. follow-ups: 5 open (images, SDK snippet, UI meter rename, billing CSV sample, Dedicated note).

Maria Gonzalez: thanks team. I'm going to split follow-ups into separate small PRs to move faster. tagging this thread closed for coordination; reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
